description: Standing push-up performed against a wall to reduce joint and spinal load.
safety_notes: Maintain a neutral spine and avoid excessive hyperextension of wrists.

description: Hands placed on an elevated sturdy surface, reducing bodyweight percentage lifted.
safety_notes: Keep body in a straight plank line without sagging hips or hiking glutes.

description: Push-up variation performed with knees supporting lower body weight.
safety_notes: Avoid overarching the lumbar spine; keep core braced and elbows at 45 degrees.

description: Foundational horizontal upper body pressing exercise from full plank position.
safety_notes: Prevent elbow flare beyond 45-60 degrees to safeguard anterior shoulder capsule.

description: Narrow base push-up with thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond under chest.
safety_notes: High wrist and triceps tendon load; abort if acute wrist discomfort occurs.

description: Push-up executed with feet elevated on a sturdy surface, shifting load upward.
safety_notes: Requires strong abdominal bracing to avoid lumbar sagging under inverted angle.

description: Hips hinged high in an inverted V-shape, targeting the deltoids vertically.
safety_notes: Descend forward forming a tripod with hands and crown; do not drop head directly down.

description: Feet placed upon a bench/box while hands are on the floor, increasing vertical load.
safety_notes: Requires significant shoulder strength; ensure secure footing on the elevation.

description: Inverted static isometric hold against a supportive wall surface.
safety_notes: Maintain continuous shoulder protraction and exit safely if fatigue occurs.

description: Hands resting on seat edge with knees bent, lowering hips downwards.
safety_notes: Keep spine close to the chair edge; avoid anterior shoulder roll or overextension.

description: Seated on mat with knees bent, pressing through palms to lift pelvis and isolate triceps.
safety_notes: Keep fingertips facing forward towards heels and avoid shrugging into neck.

description: Dip performed with feet elevated on a second platform or chair.
safety_notes: Do not lower shoulders past elbow depth to safeguard acromioclavicular joints.

description: Lying face down, arms raised in a 45-degree Y shape with thumbs pointed to ceiling.
safety_notes: Isolate mid-to-lower scapular upward rotation without arching lumbar spine.

description: Prone position with arms out perpendicular to torso, squeezing shoulder blades.
safety_notes: Keep forehead gently down or resting on a small towel to avoid cervical strain.

description: Prone position with elbows bent into a W shape, externally rotating shoulders.
safety_notes: Focus on controlled scapular retraction; do not violently whip the arms.

description: Isometric back extension with chest lifted, palms rotated outwards, thumbs up.
safety_notes: Avoid hyperextending cervical spine; gaze remains fixed toward the mat.

description: Plank-based retraction and protraction of the shoulder blades without bending elbows.
safety_notes: Maintain rigid core alignment; motion occurs strictly at the shoulder girdle.

description: Grasping a sturdy doorframe or vertical support while leaning back, rowing chest forward.
safety_notes: Ensure non-slip footing and firm grip on the solid door jamb.

description: Squat pattern sitting back until touching chair seat and standing back up.
safety_notes: Keep knees tracking over toes without caving inwards (valgus collapse).

description: Hinging back to lightly tap a box or chair without unloading tension before standing.
safety_notes: Do not bounce off surface; maintain continuous muscular tension and upright torso.

description: Full free-standing bodyweight squat to parallel depth.
safety_notes: Maintain heel contact with the floor throughout the entire movement range.

description: Wide stance squat with toes flared out 30-45 degrees, emphasizing hip adductors.
safety_notes: Keep knees pointed in the direction of the toes; avoid excessive forward lean.

description: Isometric squat held with back flat against wall and thighs parallel to ground.
safety_notes: Keep knees at a 90-degree angle directly above ankles; do not rest hands on thighs.

description: Reverse stepping lunge with one hand holding a chair or wall for balance.
safety_notes: Step far enough back so front knee remains behind front toes at the bottom.

description: Freestanding step back into a 90-degree lunge, returning to upright stance.
safety_notes: Control back knee descent to prevent slamming against the floor.

description: Stepping forward into deceleration lunge and pushing firmly back to start.
safety_notes: Demands greater patellar deceleration; avoid letting knee jut forward excessively.

description: Continuous forward traveling lunges alternating lead legs across open space.
safety_notes: Maintain steady rhythm and upright torso posture throughout transitions.

description: Stepping backward and across behind the front leg to engage gluteus medius.
safety_notes: Monitor front knee rotation; keep front foot anchored flat on floor.

description: Stationary lunge stance lowering and raising vertically without stepping.
safety_notes: Evenly distribute weight between front foot and rear ball of foot.

description: Single-leg split squat with rear foot elevated on a chair or bench.
safety_notes: High demand on knee stabilizers and hip mobility; ensure stable front foot placement.

description: Supine hip extension driving through heels to align knees, hips, and shoulders.
safety_notes: Squeeze glutes at peak without over-arching the lumbar spine.

description: Glute bridge performed on one leg while opposing leg is held extended or bent.
safety_notes: Keep pelvis level horizontally; avoid dropping the non-working hip.

description: Glute bridge with soles of feet pressed together and knees flared wide.
safety_notes: Keep chin tucked and focus contraction directly into the gluteal muscles.

description: Elevating heels off the floor onto balls of feet with full ankle plantarflexion.
safety_notes: Control the eccentric descent; avoid bouncing at bottom of the movement.

description: Unilateral plantarflexion on a single foot to double relative loading.
safety_notes: Place one fingertip on a wall for safety balance if ankle wobbles.

description: Lying on side, lifting top straight leg upward with toes pointing slightly downward.
safety_notes: Do not roll hips backward; maintain pelvis stacked perpendicular to mat.

description: Side-lying with knees bent at 90 degrees, opening top knee while feet remain touching.
safety_notes: Prevent pelvis from rolling backwards during knee abduction.

description: On all fours, lifting one bent knee laterally away from body without tilting torso.
safety_notes: Keep shoulders and hips square to the ground; avoid spinal twist.

description: Isometric core hold resting on forearms and knees with neutral spine.
safety_notes: Avoid letting lower back arch or hips sag towards the ground.

description: Standard prone isometric hold supported on forearms and toes.
safety_notes: Maintain continuous posterior pelvic tilt; stop immediately if lumbar sagging occurs.

description: Straight-arm plank holding the top position of a standard push-up.
safety_notes: Stack shoulders vertically over wrists; spread fingers wide for base support.

description: Lateral core hold with forearm on mat and knees bent supporting lower body.
safety_notes: Keep elbow directly under shoulder and maintain elevated lateral hip line.

description: Full lateral plank balancing on one forearm and outer edge of feet.
safety_notes: Prevent hips from rotating forward or dropping downwards toward the floor.

description: Side plank balancing on extended straight arm with feet stacked or staggered.
safety_notes: High wrist stability requirement; adjust to forearm if wrist discomfort occurs.

description: Supine cross-pattern arm and opposite leg extension while pressing lumbar into mat.
safety_notes: Crucial: lower back must stay completely glued to the mat without arching.

description: Quadruped position extending opposite arm and leg parallel to floor with stable torso.
safety_notes: Move slowly without shifting pelvis side-to-side or overarching lower back.

description: Holding a glute bridge while alternately lifting each knee toward chest.
safety_notes: Maintain strict horizontal pelvis level; prevent hips from dipping during march.

description: High plank alternating hand taps to the opposing shoulder while resisting rotation.
safety_notes: Widen feet to shoulder-width to minimize pelvic rocking side to side.

description: Hovering knees 2 inches above the ground from an all-fours tabletop stance.
safety_notes: Keep shins parallel to ground and spine neutral; do not pike hips up.

description: Supine knee tuck and tap with bent knees, engaging lower abdominal wall.
safety_notes: Ensure lower back maintains contact with mat throughout descent.

description: Supine raising and lowering straight legs to hover above floor.
safety_notes: Stop lowering legs if lower spine begins to peel up or arch from floor.

description: Supine hold with shoulder blades lifted and knees tucked closely to chest.
safety_notes: Tuck chin slightly and drive lumbar spine firmly downward into mat.

description: Full gymnastics hollow body hold with arms overhead and legs fully extended.
safety_notes: Extremely demanding core exercise; immediately regress if back arches off floor.

description: Supine rapid alternating vertical kicks with straight legs hovering low.
safety_notes: Keep hands by sides or under tailbone to assist neutral pelvic tilt if needed.

description: Supine horizontal crisscrossing of straight legs over and under each other.
safety_notes: Maintain small, controlled crossing motions; prevent excessive momentum.

description: Seated V-sit rotation of torso with heels resting on floor for stability.
safety_notes: Rotate through the thoracic ribcage rather than twisting lower back aggressively.

description: Seated V-sit rotation performed with feet floating off floor in balance.
safety_notes: Keep chest open and avoid rounding upper back into excessive kyphosis.

description: Supine curling of shoulder blades off mat by contracting rectus abdominis.
safety_notes: Do not yank neck forward with hands; focus on ribs curling toward pelvis.

description: Supine posterior pelvic curl curling tailbone and hips slightly off mat toward ribcage.
safety_notes: Use abdominal tension rather than swinging legs for momentum.

description: Supine alternating elbow-to-knee rotation with reciprocating bicycle leg motion.
safety_notes: Perform slowly with deliberate pause; avoid pulling aggressively on head.

description: Low-impact burpee where feet step back into plank one at a time with no jump.
safety_notes: Step smoothly into high plank without letting hips plummet.

description: Explosive squat thrust kicking back into plank and jumping upward overhead.
safety_notes: Land softly with knees slightly bent; brace core upon landing in plank.

description: Burpee incorporating a full strict push-up at the bottom of each repetition.
safety_notes: High cardiovascular and muscular demand; preserve push-up form under fatigue.

description: Forward fold walking hands out to high plank, then walking back to stand.
safety_notes: Bend knees slightly if hamstring flexibility limits comfortable floor reach.

description: Inchworm walkout culminating in a full chest-to-floor push-up before return.
safety_notes: Pause momentarily in solid plank before initiating the push-up.

description: High plank bringing knees forward alternately in slow, controlled tempo.
safety_notes: Keep hips low and level; avoid bouncing pelvis upward during transitions.

description: Rapid reciprocating running knee drive from high plank position.
safety_notes: Maintain shoulders directly over hands; keep toes light on floor touch.

description: Driving knee diagonally toward the opposite elbow to increase oblique engagement.
safety_notes: Control rotation through mid-back rather than twisting knees awkwardly.

description: Dynamic flow shifting from high plank back into downward-facing dog stretch.
safety_notes: Press actively through palms and engage shoulders during hip elevation.

description: Contralateral crawling motion staying low to ground with knees hovering.
safety_notes: Move opposite arm and leg simultaneously in short, controlled strides.

description: Supine quadruped crawl with hips raised, traveling forward and backward.
safety_notes: Requires wrist and shoulder extension; ease into range if joints are stiff.

description: Full multi-step transition from lying supine to standing upright with arm raised.
safety_notes: Execute each distinct transition point with deliberate control and focus.

description: Standing heel-to-toe in a single line, challenging lateral postural sway.
safety_notes: Keep near a wall or chair for quick recovery if losing balance.

description: Balancing upright on one foot with other knee lifted to hip level.
safety_notes: Engage standing glute and fix visual gaze on a static reference point.

description: Single-leg balance with eyes shut, relying purely on vestibular and proprioceptive cues.
safety_notes: Ensure a clear radius around you free of sharp obstacles.

description: Standing on one leg, reaching non-standing foot to 12, 3, 6, and 9 o'clock positions.
safety_notes: Maintain knee alignment over the middle toes on supporting leg.

description: Unilateral hip hinge extending trailing leg straight back while torso lowers parallel.
safety_notes: Keep pelvis square to the floor; avoid rotating non-weightbearing hip upwards.

description: Holding lifted knee tightly at 90-degree flexion with tall spine posture.
safety_notes: Do not lean back to compensate for hip flexor tightness.

description: Isometric single-leg hinge with arms extended laterally like airplane wings.
safety_notes: Maintain soft microbend in standing knee to protect knee joint capsule.

description: Rocking forward onto ball of foot and back to heel while balanced on one leg.
safety_notes: Use wall support initially if experiencing acute balance loss.

description: Reaching free foot along anterior, posteromedial, and posterolateral vectors.
safety_notes: Keep standing heel anchored firmly to floor during maximum reach.

description: Pistol-style single-leg squat with fingertip support on wall for balance guidance.
safety_notes: Descend only to depth where ankle mobility allows flat heel contact.

description: Quadruped segmental flexion and extension of the entire vertebral column.
safety_notes: Synchronize movement with breathing; do not force cervical hyperextension.

description: Restorative kneeling stretch sitting hips back toward heels with arms outstretched.
safety_notes: Widen knees if hip impingement occurs; support forehead with pillow if needed.

description: Inverted V-posture lengthening posterior chain while pushing away with shoulders.
safety_notes: Pedal feet gently if hamstrings are tight; maintain elongated spine.

description: Deep lunge with inside elbow reach followed by thoracic rotation overhead.
safety_notes: Keep back knee off or lightly on floor; rotate from ribcage, not lower back.

description: Ground hip opening pose targeting deep piriformis and external rotator complex.
safety_notes: Place folded towel under hip if pelvis does not reach mat comfortably.

description: Gentle anterior chain spinal extension pressing gently through forearms or palms.
safety_notes: Do not force range of motion if experiencing sharp pinch in lumbar spine.

description: Half-kneeling posture tucking pelvis under to stretch front of rear hip.
safety_notes: Engage rear glute to intensify stretch; do not hyperextend lower back.

description: Seated with soles together, knees dropping outward to stretch groin.
safety_notes: Keep spine tall; do not forcefully bounce knees toward the ground.

description: Standing on one leg, pulling opposite heel toward glute with knees together.
safety_notes: Hold a wall for balance; avoid arching lower spine during hold.

description: On all fours, sliding one arm across under body to mobilize upper back and shoulder.
safety_notes: Rest head and shoulder gently on the floor; breathe naturally.

description: Low-impact jumping jack variation stepping one foot laterally at a time.
safety_notes: Ideal low-impact cardiovascular alternative avoiding ground reaction shock.

description: Classic calisthenic jumping drill with simultaneous arm overhead abduction.
safety_notes: Land softly on balls of feet with knees slightly bent to cushion impact.

description: Jumping jack variation clapping hands horizontally in front of chest.
safety_notes: Promotes chest opening; maintain soft landings on forefoot.

description: Standing high knee marching in place at steady, controlled cadence.
safety_notes: Low-impact cardio option; pump opposite arms rhythmically.

description: Explosive running in place driving knees above hip level with quick turnover.
safety_notes: High ground impact; land on balls of feet and keep core braced.

description: Jogging in place driving heels rapidly backward towards glutes.
safety_notes: Keep thighs pointing largely downwards; land gently.

description: Lateral bounding from side to side landing on single leg with rear leg trailing.
safety_notes: Cushion each lateral landing by flexing ankle, knee, and hip simultaneously.

description: Rhythmic combination punching (jab, cross, hook) with light footwork.
safety_notes: Do not snap or hyperextend elbow joints at end of punch trajectory.
